turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Hello, this is Officer Mark Dsouza from the CBI cyber crime division.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: A FedEx parcel in your name was seized at customs with illegal items.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I did not order any parcel.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Your Aadhaar was used. This is a money laundering case and a warrant is issued.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: You will be arrested immediately unless you cooperate with this investigation.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Please, I have done nothing wrong.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: This is confidential. Do not tell anyone, not even your family.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Stay on this video call and do not disconnect until I say so.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Download AnyDesk from the app store so I can verify your phone.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Share the nine digit code. I will start screen sharing now.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: To prove your innocence, transfer a verification deposit to the RBI safe account.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: How much do I have to send?

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Transfer Rs 3,50,000 within 30 minutes. It is fully refundable.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I need to go to the bank for that.

turns.speaker: scammer
turns.text: Do not tell the bank staff the reason. This is your last warning.
